We're Hiring | Senior AI Engineer / Lead AI Engineer | Gurgaon & Pune | Hybrid

NetConnect Global is hiring for a leading client.

Location: Gurgaon / Pune (Hybrid)
Role: Lead AI Engineer
Experience: 7+ Years
CTC: 32 LPA
Employment Type: Full-Time
Project Duration: 12 Months

Mandatory Skills

Agentic AI & Generative AI
Python, FastAPI
LangChain, LangGraph
RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
Large Language Models (LLMs)
Prompt Engineering
Docker & Kubernetes
AWS / Azure
Vector Databases (Pinecone, Qdrant, pgvector)
CI/CD & MLOps

Key Responsibilities

Build production-grade LLM applications and Agentic AI workflows.
Develop scalable RAG pipelines, AI agents, and tool integrations.
Design FastAPI-based AI services and integrate enterprise data sources.
Deploy AI solutions using Docker, Kubernetes, AWS/Azure.
Implement observability, guardrails, hallucination detection, and AI optimization.
Collaborate with Architects and Data Scientists to deliver enterprise AI solutions.

Qualification: B.E./B.Tech./M.Tech./M.Sc. in Computer Science, IT, AI, Data Science, or related field.

Interested candidates, please share your updated resume to:
Sakshita.a@netconnectglobal.com
